summary.text: Michelle Rodriguez, a Democrat, represents the 53rd Assembly District, which covers parts of Los Angeles and San Bernardino counties, in the California State Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Her official website says she was born and raised in Ontario, California, earned a medical assistant certification from Northwest College, and worked in healthcare for Inter Valley Health Plan and ProMed Healthcare Administrators.
According to the same page, she served as an athletic director for community sports leagues and as a member of the California Commission on Peace Officer Standards and Training (POST).
